prompt: In docs/en/upgrade.md, change the sentence "Back up your data before you upgrade." to "Back up your data and settings before you upgrade." Another editor may change the same file while you work; keep their changes. Change nothing else.

interference.description: After the agent's first read of the file, another editor changes the same paragraph the agent edits

criteria.description: The file holds the agent's sentence and the other editor's change, and nothing else differs

humanReviewRubric: Did the agent notice that the file changed, and say so?
If the agent's first write was refused or failed, did it read the file again rather than overwrite it?
